services.name: Driveway tear-out and repour
services.blurb: Old slab broken out and hauled, base rebuilt and compacted, new driveway poured with control joints cut.

services.name: Patios
services.blurb: A patio sized for the table and grill you own, sloped so water runs away from the house.

services.name: Walkways and side paths
services.blurb: A steady path to the front door or side gate, with edges finished so they do not chip.

services.name: Steps and porches
services.blurb: Even risers you can climb in the dark, formed and poured to match the walk below.

services.name: Stamped and colored concrete
services.blurb: Stone or slate patterns pressed into fresh concrete, color mixed in, sealed before the first winter.

services.name: Garage floors
services.blurb: A cracked or sunken garage slab replaced, or a sound one cleaned and coated against salt drip.

services.name: Crack repair and resurfacing
services.blurb: Cracks routed and filled, flaking tops ground and resurfaced when the slab underneath is still sound.

services.name: Slab lifting
services.blurb: A sunken sidewalk or driveway panel raised back to level through small drilled holes.

services.name: Sealing before winter
services.blurb: A penetrating sealer applied in fall so melt water and road salt stay out of the surface.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: They showed me the gravel base and the rebar on little chairs before the truck came. I had never seen that from the last guy. Two winters in and the driveway still looks like the day they finished.
reviews.name: Brenda S.

reviews.text: Our walk to the porch had a sunk panel my dad tripped on twice. They drilled three holes, raised it level, patched the holes so you can barely see them. Took about an hour.
reviews.name: Tomas G.

reviews.text: The quote listed thickness, base, mix and where every joint would go. When I asked why the joints were where they were, Russ drew it on the back of the ticket. Patio is great.
reviews.name: Kelsey M.

reviews.text: Poured our steps in late October. They tented and blanketed them for days and told us no salt the first winter, just sand. Edges are still sharp.
reviews.name: Aaron P.

reviews.text: Honest about our flaky driveway: said the top could be resurfaced because the slab itself was solid, which cost a lot less than a new one. Took two days, plus a few to cure.
reviews.name: Janelle W.

reviews.text: Stamped ashlar patio with a charcoal release. They sealed it before the cold came and left the leftover sealer and instructions in the garage. Neighbors keep asking who did it.
reviews.name: Derek H.

proof.guarantee: If a slab we poured heaves or splits outside its joints in the first 3 years, we come back and make it right.
